name: Nifty Sniper: The Office Protocol
description: A precision system designed to capture 30 points between 09:25 AM and 10:15 AM. We exploit the initial market waves (Support/Resistance interactions) and exit before the mid-morning chop to focus on office work.

steps.title: 09:15 - 09:25 (The Download)
items: DO NOT TRADE. Watch the Open.
Assess Open Type: Gap Up (Profit Booking?) or Flat?
NO SETUP = NO TRADE. Do not force it.

steps.title: 09:25 - 09:45 (The Entry Window)
items: Market participation increases. Look for the setup.
Buy at Support (Call) or Sell at Resistance (Put).
Wait for a candle close confirmation.
Entry must align with the immediate trend.

steps.title: 10:15 AM (The Hard Stop)
items: Target is 30 points. SL is 30 points. Exit which hits first
If target or SL is not hit by 10:15 AM, EXIT the market whatever the P/L
Close terminal. Shift focus to Office Work.

rules.title: OFFICE HARD STOP
rules.description: At 10:15 AM, the trading day ends. Win, Loss, or Breakeven. My job is priority #1 after this time.

rules.title: 30 POINTS OR NOTHING
rules.description: The goal is precise. Don't be greedy for 100 points. Get the chunk and get out. 30 Points rule is invalid if exit time is beyond 10:00AM

rules.title: NO SETUP = NO TRADE
rules.description: If the market is choppy or confusing by 09:45, simply close the laptop. Preserving capital is a win.
